<style>
#styling-journal,#vora-faq { scroll-margin-top:100px; }
.vora-faq-question { position:relative; list-style:none; }
.vora-faq-question::-webkit-details-marker { display:none; }
.vora-faq-question::after { content:'+'; position:absolute; right:0; top:22px; font-size:19px; font-weight:300; }
.vora-faq-item[open]>.vora-faq-question::after { content:'−'; }
.vora-faq-question:focus-visible,.vora-editorial-button:focus-visible,.vora-faq-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #171717; outline-offset:5px; }
#vora-reviews .frame-130 { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); align-items:stretch; gap:40px; }
#vora-reviews .container-5,#vora-reviews .container-7,#vora-reviews .container-9 { width:auto; height:auto; display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
#vora-reviews .container-6,#vora-reviews .container-8,#vora-reviews .testimonials,#vora-reviews .testimonial { height:100%; width:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
#vora-reviews .quote-2 { margin:0 0 24px; }
#vora-reviews .description-3 { margin-top:auto; }
@media(max-width:767px) { #vora-reviews .frame-130 { grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:42px; } }
.vora-faq-layout > header { position:sticky; top:110px; } @media(max-width:767px) { .vora-faq-layout > header { position:static; } }
</style>
savedProfileCode:
<style>
.vora-saved-profile { position:fixed; right:24px; bottom:64px; z-index:90; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:46px; padding:12px 20px; border:1px solid #222; border-radius:28px; background:#171717; color:#fff; font:11px/1.4 Arial,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; letter-spacing:1.2px; box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12); }
.vora-saved-profile:hover { background:#333; color:#fff; } .vora-saved-profile:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #171717; outline-offset:4px; }
@media(max-width:767px) { .vora-saved-profile { right:16px; bottom:64px; font-size:10px; padding:12px 16px; } }
</style><script>
(function(){
 function update(){
  var existing=document.querySelector('.vora-saved-profile');
  var valid=false;
  try{var raw=sessionStorage.getItem('vora_style_profile_v1');var p=raw&&raw.length<512?JSON.parse(raw):null;
   valid=!!p&&['hourglass','rectangle','triangle','inverted-triangle'].indexOf(p.bodyType)>-1&&typeof p.createdAt==='number'&&p.createdAt<=Date.now()&&Date.now()-p.createdAt<43200000;
  }catch(e){}
  if(!valid){if(existing)existing.remove();return;}
  if(existing)return;
  var link=document.createElement('a');link.className='vora-saved-profile';link.href='/app';link.textContent='BACK TO MY VORA PROFILE';document.body.appendChild(link);
 }
 update();window.addEventListener('pageshow',update);
})();
</script>
